definitions.explanation: The underground storage organ of certain plants, from which the plant grows. Includes true bulbs (like tulips and onions), tubers, corms, and rhizomes in general usage.

examples.japanese: ⟦チューリップ→チューリップ：05487_chuurippu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{球根|きゅうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧。

examples.english: If you plant the bulbs in autumn, the flowers will bloom in spring.

examples.japanese: {球根|きゅうこん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しくて→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please store the bulbs in a cool, dark place.

notes:
{球根|きゅうこん} refers to the underground storage organ from which certain plants grow.

FORMS:
⟦{球|きゅう}→球：28895_kyuu⟧ (ball) + {根|こん} (root) — literally "ball root."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {球根|きゅうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧: to plant bulbs
- {球根|きゅうこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掘|ほ}り⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to dig up bulbs
- {球根|きゅうこん}⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧: bulb plants

WELL-KNOWN BULB PLANTS:
- ⟦チューリップ→チューリップ：05487_chuurippu⟧: tulips
- ユリ: lilies
- ヒヤシンス: hyacinths
- スイセン: daffodils

GARDENING NOTE:
Many {球根|きゅうこん} are planted in ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ (autumn) for ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ (spring) blooms. After flowering, bulbs are often dug up, dried, and stored for replanting.
